rows.Title: Lifting posture
rows.LookFor: Load held close, knees bent, no twisting while lifting; lift aids used where provided.

rows.Title: Reaching
rows.LookFor: No reaching above shoulder or below knee to do the task; no overreaching or lateral bending.

rows.Title: Repetitive motion / awkward posture
rows.LookFor: Repeated motions, sustained bending, twisting or kneeling; pacing, rotation and breaks.

rows.Title: Workstation height
rows.LookFor: Tables, benches and controls at the right height for the task and the person.

rows.Title: Correct PPE, good condition
rows.LookFor: Required PPE for the zone and task is worn, fits, and is not worn out or damaged.

rows.Title: PPE available at point of use
rows.LookFor: Required PPE is stocked in the zone; nobody has to leave to get it.

rows.Title: Trip / slip hazards
rows.LookFor: Cords, hoses, strapping, spills, debris or uneven floor in walkways and work areas.

rows.Title: Guardrails / handrails
rows.LookFor: Present and secure wherever there is an edge, stair or platform.

rows.Title: Floor markings
rows.LookFor: Aisle, storage and hazard markings visible, accurate and respected.

rows.Title: LOTO applied where required
rows.LookFor: Stored energy isolated and locked during maintenance or clearing; lockout points visible.

rows.Title: Electrical clearance (36 in.)
rows.LookFor: 36 in. clear in front of panels; covers closed; no taped repairs or exposed conductors.

rows.Title: Chemical containers labeled, contained
rows.LookFor: GHS labels, lids on, secondary containment, SDS available.

rows.Title: Compressed gas chained / capped
rows.LookFor: Cylinders secured upright, caps on when not in use, stored by type.

rows.Title: Extinguisher / eyewash accessible
rows.LookFor: Not blocked, inspection tags current, eyewash flowing and signed.

rows.Title: Exit paths clear and marked
rows.LookFor: Exit routes free of clutter, signs lit or reflective, doors unlocked.

rows.Title: Spill / first aid kit stocked
rows.LookFor: Kits present, complete and in date.

rows.Title: Lighting adequate for task
rows.LookFor: Enough light to work and to see hazards; no burned-out fixtures in the zone.

rows.Title: Ventilation / air quality
rows.LookFor: No buildup of dust, fumes or vapors; extraction working.

rows.Title: Noise: can talk at arm's length?
rows.LookFor: If you have to shout at arm's length, hearing protection is required and should be worn.
